title: Droplet appliance image release manifest
description: WARP-663 / ADR-020. The signed catalogue of built appliance images. One manifest.json per releases repo; `droplet-image verify` checks the detached ECDSA-P256 signature over this file AND each listed asset's sha256, fail-closed. The M3.4 OTA agent consumes this same contract.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version. Bumped only on a breaking change to this schema.

images.description: Every published appliance image, newest-first by convention (not enforced).

shape.description: Deployment shape this image provisions. Named by what it IS (ADR-018) — no lifecycle-stage names.

version.description: Semver of the release (matches the git tag vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH and root package.json version).

format.description: Artifact format. Phase 1 ships `iso` (autoinstall); Phase 2 adds the preinstalled golden `raw`.

url.description: Where the asset lives. Abstracted so a too-large ISO can move to compression/object-storage without changing the CLI contract.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact bytes. `verify` recomputes and compares, fail-closed.

gitSha.description: Exact 40-char git commit the image was built from — a box's version is never ambiguous.

minDiskGiB.description: Minimum target disk size in GiB the flasher should accept for this image.
